fields.name: description
fields.label: Section description
fields.default: Self-service trial controls available to customers on trialing subscriptions.

items.label: Allow self sign-up
items.caption: Customers can create their own portal login. Their email must match the customer record or one of its contacts.

items.label: Auto-invite new customers
items.caption: Email a portal invitation to new customers (with an email address) as soon as they are created.

items.label: Identity verification on public links
items.caption: Ask customers to verify who they are before opening shared invoice or quote links.

items.label: Allow document upload
items.caption: Customers can attach supporting documents (POs, remittance advice) from the portal.

items.label: Allow document forwarding
items.caption: Customers can forward invoices and statements to other email addresses.

items.label: Prevent duplicate payments
items.caption: Block a new hosted checkout for an invoice while another payment attempt on it is still processing.

items.label: Allow saving payment methods
items.caption: Show the "save this card" option during checkout so customers can pay faster next time.

items.label: Save payment method by default
items.caption: Pre-tick the "save this card" option on hosted checkout pages.

items.label: Lock the save option
items.caption: Customers cannot untick "save this card" — useful for subscriptions that need a card on file.

items.label: Customers can extend their own trial
items.caption: Exposes the self-service "extend trial" action (1–30 days per extension) in the portal.

items.label: Activate immediately on early conversion
items.caption: When a customer converts a trial early, the subscription goes live straight away.
